page.overview:
Who is Nolan's father?

Nolan's Father was a minor character in Invincible, debuting in Season 4's flashbacks. He was the mate of an unnamed female, and the late father of Nolan.

He was Nolan's father who, together with his mate, arranged a test battle for their son in honor of his official coming of age so he could prove that he was strong enough to be ready for his adult life, to become an officer or an agent of the Viltrum Empire. But, unfortunately for him, he was one of the Viltrumites to be killed off by the Scourge Virus.

Nolan’s father was a well-built, brawny Viltrumite, with a physique and facial features very similar to his son’s in adulthood. He had black hair with a single streak of white at the front, blue eyes, and a thick, well-groomed horseshoe moustache. His broad shoulders, defined muscles, and commanding presence that conveys both strength and authority, embodying the physicality of a seasoned warrior in his prime.

During his early years as a soldier, he donned a white plain tradition Viltrumite uniform.
